_note: Launch services (D-024), grouped into three lines (D-025). Owners' own descriptions with quality claims removed (C-033). Draft copy until the owners approve (Q15).

services.name: Nurse at Home
services.text: Nursing care in the patient's own home, following the treating doctor's advice.

services.name: GDA at Home
services.text: A general duty attendant (GDA) for the patient's daily care and assistance at home.

services.name: Nursing procedures
services.text: Dressing, injections, catheter care and other procedures, done at home.

services.name: ICU care at home
services.text: A critical care set-up at home, with the staff and equipment it needs.

services.name: Doctor at Home
services.text: A doctor's consultation at home, for patients who can't easily get to a clinic.

services.name: Physiotherapy
services.text: A rehabilitation plan made for the patient, to help them move and recover at home.

services.name: Lab sample collection
services.text: Samples collected at home, so there is no trip to the lab.

services.name: Rent equipment
services.text: Hospital beds, oxygen concentrators, wheelchairs and monitors, short or long term, delivered and set up at home.

services.name: Buy equipment
services.text: Buy medical equipment outright, with delivery, installation and after-sales support.

services.name: Sell equipment back
services.text: No longer need it? Sell it back to us and we collect it from your home.
